generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The cost of the Tender processing fee shall not be refundable
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E - Procurement Portal
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class III and Above Registration
Royalty on construction materials will be deducted as per prevailing Govt. orders

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons

The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-4 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5 percent of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 & 29.1 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project

Contractor should adhere to HSE policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division, Mandya during office hours on all working days

Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shell be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work at their own cost
The contractors assessed available tender capacity will be calculated as per the clause 3.5 of STD tender document Attached

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, cost and conyence of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer - in - charge of this work
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured according to ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS ISO 14001:2015) & QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (QMS ISO 9001:2015) Policies, so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent

The tenderer who quotes amount less than amount put to tender should pay difference amount in the form of FDR purchased through any nationalized bank payable at Mandya only in favor The Executive Engineer at the time of execution of the tender agreement

One Lakh Rupees of the specified EMD should be paid in any one of the forms mentioned in Clause 13.1. Bank Guarantee/e-Bank Guarantee as per circular of Finance department GOK letter no:FD 5 EXP 12/2023 Dt:15.05.2023 must be given for the remaining amount in prescribed format. The copy of the Bank Guarantee must be scanned and submitted along with the Technical bid
Note:- If any postponement of receipt date of tender, the same will be published in the e-procurement portal

All the originals of uploaded documents in e-portal should be produced within 7 working days from the date of opening of Technical Bid at the Division Office, failing which the tender is liable for rejection. No separate communication will be made in this regard, failing which action will be taken as per tender conditions and registration rules

The contractor who participates in tenders for more than one work for which tenders are invited in this IFT, the tenderer must fulfill all the conditions and criteria cumulatively for the participated works
LOC / K-form for the stipulated amount should be submitted in the format as prescribed in the bid document only. Otherwise tender is liable for rejection
The returns submitted to the Income Tax Department. shall be uploaded or shall be produced at the time of verification of original documents at Division office

Regarding Appealing Aggrieved contractors may appeal to the prescribed (Appellant) authority within 30 days as per KTTP and appeal should be through e-proc only as per Govt.order No:pwd/445/CRN-2024(E) Bangalore DT.14-08-2024. Same will not be considered if appeal through Letters
Period for completion for the work is 6 months (including Rainy season)
GST at 18Percent shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.
GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for the delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Turn over and Profit and loss statement without UDIN Number will be rejected.
B-Value of existing commitment details should be submitted. Else the ongoing works available in the e-portal will be considered as a whole
The tenderer should submit the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) taken from the Registered Artisan/Sculptor under the State or Central Goverment of India

The Tenderer shall submit the test report and certification issued by a NABL-accredited or other recognized standard laboratory, certifying that the sculpture made, has been tested and conforms to the technical specifications and applicable standards.

itemList.description: Providing, manufacturing, supplying and assembling of Nadaprabhu Shri Kempegowda Statue in standing position madeup of bronze confirming to Grade LTB2/C83600 (Minimum Copper: 85%, lead: 5% zinc: 5%, tin: 5%) with bronze sheet of average thickness ranging from 6mm to 10mm with minimum of 3000kg of bronze weight for about 4m height and proportional dimensions in all the directions with pretreated structural steel for internal membrane/cage as per IS design withstanding all types of loads and weight as required confirming IS standards requirements fixed over standard MS Base plate supported over existing RCC pedestal. The process of manufacturing of the Bronze statue involves architectural drawings and designs as per IS Standards, Cost of all materials, clay model making, making moulds, making fibre glass statue, making plaster of paris piece moulds, making wax statue, bronze casting, welding of bronze statue in foundry, bracing with steel angles, flats with bolts and nuts, cutting Statue into required parts for transportation, hoisting parts on to pedestal, welding of steel structure and bronze parts together, the exposed surface of the statue and other bronze elements shall be oxidized to the required exstent, the external surface of the statue will be further treated with poly-urethane, Lacquer coating, final finishing and painting, installing Statue @ work spot, obtaining certificates from the concerned quality assurance authorities/Nationaly Recognised Institutes including all artists, skilled and unskilled labour, hiring of machinery, all leads and lifts, loading and unloading , transportation, placing and all other incidental charges for successful erection and completion of the work in coordination with civil works as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work.(Excluding GST) ---- All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, cost and conyence of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer - in - charge of this work
